lab_name: Agentic MSP Support Agent Guided Lab
updated_by: Amit Kumar (prepared with the CloudLabs Lab Builder)
important_note: One seat = one TEAM environment (one CloudLabs deployment, shared by the members of a team). Prices are Azure Retail Prices API list prices for swedencentral, USD, pay-as-you-go, retrieved 2026-10-01; no EA/CSP discount, reservation or free grant is applied (shared billing accounts are assumed to have used the Log Analytics 5 GB, Container Apps and semantic ranker free allowances). Token rows are estimates for a 5-hour session with heavy experimentation; the overage row covers up to three times that usage. The Power Apps Developer Plan is free but must be assigned to every team account; Microsoft licensing should confirm that one Developer Plan account per team is acceptable for this training delivery. Model quota: 30K TPM per team for gpt-5.4-mini and text-embedding-3-small, so 25 teams need 750K TPM of each in the subscription and region.

resources.name: Lab VM
resources.notes: Virtual Machines Dsv5 Series Windows, meter D4s v5, $0.388/hour x 730. Auto-shutdown at 00:00 UTC.

resources.name: Browser RDP container (CloudLabs)
resources.type_size: Azure Container Instances Linux, 1 vCPU, 1.5 GB
resources.notes: Standard vCPU Duration $0.0466/hour + Standard Memory Duration $0.00511/GB-hour x 1.5 = $0.054265/hour x 730.

resources.name: VM OS disk
resources.notes: Standard SSD Managed Disks, meter E10 LRS Disk, $9.60/month; operations ($0.002 per 10K) negligible.

resources.name: Public IP address
resources.notes: IP Addresses, meter Standard IPv4 Static Public IP, $0.005/hour x 730.

resources.name: Azure AI Search
resources.type_size: Basic, 1 search unit, semantic ranker free plan
resources.notes: Azure AI Search, meter Basic Unit, $0.101/hour x 730. Fixed: about 300 semantic ranker queries at $1 per 1K (Semantic Ranker queries meter).

resources.name: Azure API Management
resources.notes: API Management, meter Basic v2 Unit, $0.27/hour x 730. Fixed: under 10K calls at the Basic v2 Calls meter ($0.04 per 10K).

resources.name: Azure Container Apps (MCP server)
resources.type_size: Consumption, 0.5 vCPU / 1 GiB, 1 replica always on
resources.notes: Standard vCPU Active Usage $0.000024/s x 0.5 + Standard Memory Active Usage $0.000003/GiB-s, x 3600 x 730. Conservative: billed at active rates (idle rate would be about $11.83/month). Consumption-only environment: no Environment Management Hour charge.

resources.name: Azure Container Registry
resources.notes: Container Registry, meter Basic Registry Unit, $0.1666/day x 30.4167. Fixed: about 3 ACR Tasks builds x 4 minutes at $0.0001 per task-second (the API shows the first 6,000 seconds at $0).

resources.name: Azure Key Vault
resources.notes: Key Vault, meter Operations, $0.03 per 10K operations; a few thousand secret reads.

resources.name: Log Analytics workspace (incl. workspace-based Application Insights)
resources.notes: Analytics Logs Data Ingestion $2.99/GB above the free 5 GB (assumed consumed in a shared billing account); about 0.2 GB of API Management, Container Apps and agent trace data per team. Retention within the included 31 days.

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry: gpt-5.4-mini
resources.notes: Azure OpenAI GPT5 meters 5.4 mini Inp Gl $0.75/1M, 5.4 mini Opt Gl $4.50/1M. Estimate per team: 3.75M input + 0.375M output tokens (about 90 user turns, 250 model calls with retrieval and tool results).

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry: text-embedding-3-small
resources.notes: Meter text-embedding-3-small-glbl Tokens, $0.00002 per 1K. Two index loads of about 100K tokens plus query vectors.

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service
resources.type_size: Prompt agent with Azure AI Search and MCP tools
resources.notes: No charge for creating or running prompt agents; the tools bill through their own resources (rows above).

resources.name: Power Platform developer environment (Dataverse)
resources.type_size: Developer environment, up to 2 GB Dataverse
resources.notes: Included with the Power Apps Developer Plan; does not consume tenant Dataverse capacity. Remove after the event (not deleted with the resource group).

resources.name: Overage: heavier model usage
resources.type_size: gpt-5.4-mini up to 3x the base estimate
resources.notes: Covers teams that experiment far beyond the guide (up to about 11M input and 1.1M output tokens). Excluded from the base total.

licenses.name: Microsoft Entra ID Free (Entra Agent ID included)

duration_details.breakdown: Launched the day before the session so provisioning (about 45 to 75 minutes) and the first log data (up to 90 minutes) are complete, with time for a facilitator check
15 min arrival + 4 hours of exercises + two 10-min breaks + 15 min wrap-up + 10 min close
Time before CloudLabs deletes the resource group
1.5 hours provisioning and checks + 5-hour session + 1.5 hours buffer; the VM is auto-shut down overnight
